fact: Decree 2023-515 of 9 May 2023 makes the unique identification number compulsory in civil status records, identity documents and public and private services, attaches it to persons recorded in the computerised civil status system (SIECM), requires civil registrars to send updates to the national civil status and identity centre, and allows interconnection with other public databases subject to CMIL authorisation.
title: Décret n° 2023-515 relatif au Numéro Unique d'Identification (NUI)
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation
